description: UI harness + dispatcher split-queue acceptance (#109), two cases. Case 1: clicking the armed AE stopwatch enqueues ClearPropertyKeyframes at runtime, and the VERY NEXT script command observes its effect (no wait between click and assert -- the script drain may not overtake pending runtime work). Case 2: CutClip's execute() enqueues DeleteClip as a runtime command with no wait state; the immediately following assert must see the clip gone -- this pins the atomic in-drain gate (a once-per-call check let script command N+1 overtake it). The **/ wildcard crosses PropertyWindow's PushID(entity) scope; '(*)' is the armed-stopwatch label, and Opacity is the only armed property so it is unambiguous.
